snippet.title: [SMBX2 Episode] Delightful Adventure 2: Double Demise - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
After years of development, the sequel to Delightful Adventure Enhanced is complete!

A strange curse has spread across the Mushroom Kingdom, and it seems to be caused by an old foe for our heroes...
Can Mario, Luigi and Captain Toad collect the Star Shards across the land and foil Wart's plans?
